## Formatting

If the underlying operation fails, retry at most 2 times before giving up and reporting the

cases.rationale: Reworded stronger (Calibration table row 3): 'Prefer' became 'Always' — no instruction added or removed, yet the threshold for following it moved.

cases.description: renderLabel is renamed to formatLabel uniformly across its definition and its one call site.
cases.rationale: Behavior-preserving rename spanning many files, review clean (Calibration table row 6): uniformly one transformation — the definition and its only call site both change together, nothing else.

cases.description: A comment-only, purely cosmetic tweak inside a file this fixture's own policy.yml lists under merge-sensitive-paths.
cases.rationale: Sensitive-path hard floor (AC 3): bin/hooks.js is listed in this fixture's own merge-sensitive-paths, so the hit renders needs-human immediately regardless of how mechanical the content change looks — no content judgment overrides this.

cases.description: The renderLabel→formatLabel rename, but one hunk also raises DEFAULT_LIMIT from 10 to 25.
cases.rationale: Rename where one hunk also changes a default (Calibration table row 7): one non-conforming hunk makes the whole diff behavior-carrying — the automerge guideline binds again.
